evidence.quote: Recovery may be painfully slow, and the economy will remain unusually vulnerable to new shocks.
Unemployment continues to rise and housing prices continue to decline.
despite some progress, financial markets continue to exhibit signs of strain. Government-provided liquidity and guarantees remain as necessary supports in many areas.
A major reorientation of our regulatory and supervisory system is needed to address head-on the problem of systemic risk.

That note leans mildly dovish, but the speech takes no monetary policy view, so overall stance is neutral.
